compute_similarity_matrix: compute a similarity matrix between visual input embeddings and text query embeddings using PACO part-attribute composition
obj_with_attributes: compute object similarity scores between input embeddings and query embeddings with object attribute matching
parts_with_attributes: compute part-level similarity scores between input embeddings and query embeddings with part attribute matching
product_attr: compute geometric mean product of attribute scores between vision and text embeddings for matching
review_compute_similarity_matrix: review the compute_similarity_matrix function for PACO evaluation input validation and similarity computation
